profile.summary:
I am a full-stack developer looking to tackle some of today's biggest challenges, through creative problem solving. I want to apply the wide breadth of knowledge/skills gained through my 10+ years of financial services experience into a development role. 

I develop with Ruby/Ruby on Rails, Sinatra, HTML/CSS, Javascript/jQuery, D3.js, node.js, Backbone.js/Marionette.js and practice TDD.
